You know how much I love swimming—it’s basically
my whole personality. So not being able to swim? It’s
the worst! I NEED to get back out in the water. I’m
sure you feel the same way, Maggie.

Ugh, I’m so tired of living like this... How long until
we can go swimming again, do you think?

Love, Rory

Look at my little Minnie and Cici! This is the best
shot I’ve ever taken of them!

I’ve been thinking about them lately, day and night.
What do you suppose they’re up to? I just keep
staring at this photo.

You told me about your partner before, right, Elena?
Wasn’t it named Mora or something? I bet it was cute,
just like its Trainer. Wish I could’ve seen it.

White sand and the blue ocean... Endless rays of sun
and the cool shade of a palm tree... Just relaxing on
my own at the beach is my favorite thing to do lately!
But I do kinda feel like I’m being watched...
Nah, it’s probably just my imagination!

Anyway, I can’t recommend this place enough.
You should all check it out sometime! Catch my
next post for more details!

My daughter’s been sobbing every night recently.
She keeps saying that she wants to see Marie, and
she just cries and cries. I tried giving her a plush toy
that looked just like Marie, but she got angry and
yelled that it wasn’t the same.

How are things with your family? I hope you’re not
going through the same thing, but if you happen to
have any ideas about what to do, please let me know.

Love, Minami

This is Mora! Adorable, right? I’m not sure this photo
does her justice, though. Just look at how gorgeous
she is, and those eyes suck you right in... She’s so
cute! Don’t you think so too, Kaz?

I also look at this photo when I’m lonely. I hope this
picture of Mora cheers you up, Kaz, even if it’s only a
little bit!

After I finish my homework today, I’m going to
Yuri’s place.

She’s gonna show me a Pawmi video, so I might be
kinda late getting home!

Love, Nathalie

Today we’ll be showing you an office where we’re
smack in the middle of developing new products!

Here, we’re in the thick of designing new plush toys.
There are plenty of Pokémon in this room! We want
to truly re-create the charm and cuteness of Pokémon,
so we spend every day in here observing the real deal!
We definitely don’t come here just to admire and
adore the Pokémon—this is research!

I was eating a sea grape salad outside a little while
ago when a nearby Pincurchin started looking at it
like it really wanted some!

I couldn’t turn down such a cute face...

I gave it just a little bit to try, and it started munching
away! It was ADORABLE! I almost want to take it
home with me...
